name: Ingersoll Rand Inc.
summary: Ingersoll Rand Inc. provides mission-critical air, fluid, clean energy, and medical technologies services and solutions worldwide. It operates in two segments, Industrial Technologies and Services, and Precision and Science Technologies. The Industrial Technologies and Services segment designs, manufactures, markets, and services a range of air and gas compression and treatment equipment, vacuum and blower products, fluid transfer equipment, loading systems, and power tools and lifting equipment; and other specialized equipment, including aftermarket parts, consumables and services, air treatment equipment, controls, other accessories, and services under the Ingersoll Rand, Gardner Denver, N…
